title: About Performance Max for store goals - Google Ads Help

facts.fact: Performance Max campaigns for store goals are designed to help businesses give potential customers the information they need to decide when and how to visit their stores.
facts.quote: Performance Max campaigns for store goals are designed to help businesses provide their potential customers the information that they need to decide when and how to visit their stores.

facts.fact: Performance Max campaigns for store goals promote stores across Google's largest properties, including the Google Search Network, Google Maps, Waze, YouTube, Gmail, and the Google Display Network.
facts.quote: promote your stores across Google’s largest properties including the Google Search Network, Google Maps, Waze, YouTube, Gmail, and the Google Display Network.

facts.fact: Advertisers provide store locations, campaign budget, and ad assets; Google AI then optimizes bids, ad placements, and asset combinations.
facts.quote: You provide us with store locations, campaign budget, and ad assets. Using these inputs, Google AI optimizes bids, ad placements, and asset combinations.

facts.fact: Performance Max campaigns for store goals aim to maximize in-store value and conversions, using store visits, store sales, and local actions such as call clicks or direction clicks.
facts.quote: The campaign aims to maximize your in-store value and conversions (using store visits, store sales, and local actions such as call clicks, or direction clicks)

facts.fact: Performance Max campaigns for store goals use radius targeting for Business Profile and affiliate local assets (ALA) locations.
facts.quote: also use radius targeting for the Business Profile and affiliate local assets (ALA) locations

facts.fact: If no specific radius is set, the radius for store goals campaigns is automatically determined and depends on the targeted locations and a user's preferred travel distance to them.
facts.quote: This automatically determined radius will depend on the targeted locations and a user’s preference of travel distance to them.

facts.fact: The page lists vertical, population density, and existing competitors as other factors that determine the targeted radius for store goals campaigns.
